skills.description: Using a fixed camera at home or in the office, the system analyzes daily videos of an individual (e.g., adult, adolescent) and detects anxiety-related behaviors: hand rubbing (repeated rubbing of both hands), nail biting (hand approaching mouth with biting motion), and pacing (repeated back-and-forth walking in a small area).
